Arjun: Hi all, onboarding snag. I accepted the org invite but it still shows me as 'pending member' and I can't open private repo 'onboarding-scripts'. Using my personal github account and also have a redwood email invite. any tips?

Felix (People Ops): @Arjun welcome! Two common causes: 1) you accepted the invite with a different GitHub account, or 2) SSO/2FA wasn't completed. Can you check under https://github.com/settings/emails and confirm your work email is listed on the account you used?

Arjun: my personal account has my personal email and the work email is listed as secondary. I clicked the invite from my work inbox though.

Priya (EngAdmin): If the work email is secondary on your personal account GitHub can still consider that a different identity for SSO. Quick diagnostics: run `gh auth status` and `ssh -T git@github.com` and paste outputs. Also try opening the invite link in an incognito window and sign in explicitly with your work account.

Arjun: gh auth status shows I'm logged in as arjun-personal. ssh test returns: "Hi arjun-personal! You've successfully authenticated..."

it-onboard-bot: [system] Ticket created: #128 - "GitHub org membership pending for Arjun". Assigned to EngAdmin.

Priya (EngAdmin): OK that confirms it. You likely accepted under arjun-personal. Two options: A) add your work email to arjun-personal as a primary and enable SSO, or B) sign out and create/sign-in to the org using your work account and accept invite there. If you prefer we can re-send invite to the other account. Which do you want to do?

Arjun: I want to keep my personal account separate. Can you resend to my work account please? Work username is arjun-rw.

Priya (EngAdmin): Done — resent invite to arjun-rw. Also make sure 2FA is enabled on arjun-rw: https://github.com/settings/security. After accepting, go to https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference and click "Configure SSO".

Arjun: accepted invite via incognito, did SSO flow, enabled 2FA. gh auth status now shows arjun-rw. But when I try `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/onboarding-scripts.git` it errors with permission denied (publickey).

Priya (EngAdmin): That means your SSH key isn't added to the arjun-rw account. Run `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "arjun@redwood.com"` (if you don't have a key), then `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` and add that to https://github.com/settings/ssh/new on the arjun-rw account.

Noor: If you need a quick temporary workaround you can clone over HTTPS with `git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-scripts.git` and authenticate with `gh auth login` when prompted.

Arjun: added the key and `ssh -T` now says "Hi arjun-rw!" Clone succeeded. Thanks everyone.

Arjun: one last question: will I be auto-added to team 'eng-new-hires' or do I need to request it?

Priya (EngAdmin): People Ops auto-adds new hires to eng-new-hires. If you don't see it in a few minutes ping me and I'll add you manually.

Felix (People Ops): Confirmed on our side, arjun-rw added to eng-new-hires. Welcome to Redwood Inference! :tada:
